description.value: Mountain Spirit Resort is an all-suite luxury hotel situated at the base of Kimberley Alpine Resort, offering ski-in/ski-out access and a year-round outdoor heated pool and hot tub. As part of the Northstar Group, it provides suites ranging from studio to three-bedroom configurations, making it a well-appointed base for mountain adventurers. Touring cyclists will find dedicated bike storage and complimentary high-speed WiFi among the listed property amenities.
